# CANDIDATE: SVR_BEAR_ORB_BREAK_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated FINRA Short Volume Ratio (SVR > 0.55) indicates bearish dealer positioning, increasing the probability of continuation after an opening-range low breakdown. Entry occurs when SVR is high, price breaks below the opening-range low with elevated volume (>1.5x 5-bar average), and the bar closes near its low (close < open). This captures institutional short-sale momentum during low-volatility regimes (VIX < 15) after the opening range is established.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** At close of the bar where:  
  (1) FINRA_SVR > 0.55 (same-day value)  
  (2) Price breaks below the opening-range low (ORL)  
  (3) Volume > 1.5 × average volume of prior 5 bars  
  (4) Close < open (bearish close)  
  (5) Time ≥ 10:00 EST (after OR establishment)  
  (6) VIX spot < 15 (low-volatility regime)  
  (7) Avoid high-impact news windows (checked via automation/state/news.json)  
- **Exit:**  
  - Stop: Chart-stop at opening-range high (ORH) — structure invalidation  
  - TP1: 2R (risk-reward)  
  - Runner: Chandelier exit (ATR × 3) or 20% off high-water mark, whichever is tighter  
- **Position sizing:** Per risk-rules.md (min 3 contracts, scaled by account equity)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md scaling table).  
2. **Sample bias:** Mechanism evidence from BS-synthetic run over 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Sample includes all SPY bars meeting time/VIX/news filters. Overfit risk: SVR threshold (0.55) and volume multiplier (1.5×) are arbitrary; walk-forward needed to validate robustness.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no WF/OOS test conducted; mechanism evidence only).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-synthetic pricing used; real OPRA fills may differ ±10-30% on illiquid 0DTE per L23).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 5/04 extreme volatility could trigger false ORB breaks (whipsaw risk).  
   - Max drawdown: BS-synthetic run showed $4,701.52 drawdown (artifact: max_drawdown).

6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 99.9% of wide_pnl in BS-synthetic run (artifact: top5_pct=999.0) — extreme concentration driven by 5/04 outlier. Requires real-fills validation to assess true concentration.
